e.title: Forvis 精算建模革命
e.summary: Forvis Mazars：精算建模的革命——保险业下一步的建模分析
e.body:
Forvis Mazars「The revolution of actuarial modelling」：精算建模革命的分析——保险业建模方法/技术的变革（Forvis 专业机构视角）。对 RIAA：精算建模变革的专业分析——与 [[milliman-python-actuarial-platform]]（Python 建模）、[[actuaries-beyond-excel]]（Excel 迁移）配套：建模革命的机构论证；理解「精算建模革命」的内容（技术/方法/人才）；配合 [[hybrid-actuarial-role]]（角色变化）理解建模岗的未来；精算建模课程/求职的行业视角。

## 同类工具
[[fp198-dl-ldi]]、[[gamlss]]、[[hardhat]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_hk: Forvis Mazars：精算建模的革命——保險業下一步的建模分析
e.body_en:
Forvis Mazars 'The revolution of actuarial modelling': an analysis of the actuarial-modelling revolution — the transformation of insurance-modelling methods/technology (professional-firm view). For RIAA: a professional analysis of the actuarial-modelling revolution — with [[milliman-python-actuarial-platform]] (Python modelling) and [[actuaries-beyond-excel]] (Excel migration) it forms multi-firm arguments of the modelling revolution; understand the content of 'the actuarial-modelling revolution' (technology/methods/talent); with [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] (role changes) understand the future of modelling roles; an industry view for modelling courses and jobs.

## Similar tools
